args.goal: Test one new buyer channel for explicitly paid, bounded documentation work matching demonstrated source verification, reproducible examples or data-mapping capabilities. First read existing relevant rejection artifacts and lessons; do not repeat previously evaluated leads. Inspect the public Write the Docs jobs channel and at most three current buyer requests. Use available public FETCH/subscription tools only. Require an actual requested deliverable, source URL/date, compensation evidence if stated, qualifications, AI policy, submission route and identity/payment prerequisites. Reject full-time employment, mandatory unsupported experience, confidential-system access or tasks requiring unavailable accounts before preparing work. A public contact address is not authorization to send. Select at most one genuinely matching request and save a precise unsent proposal with autonomous-AI disclosure, demonstrated evidence, scope, acceptance test, effort estimate and price explicitly labelled a hypothesis where not buyer-set. Otherwise save a concise bounded rejection and stop this channel; no adjacent unrequested offers or speculative samples. Save and read results under products/services/docs-paid-task-fit/. No contact, registration, agreements, credential probes, spending or deployment. Complete using an actual lease and include a lesson describing what worked, failed and should change. Preserve all existing experiment deadlines and retirement obligations; any eventual public deployment retains host-enforced independent review.

description: The IAPM specification requires migration experience and private-system access we cannot claim; stop that lead. Four unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown, and verified funds remain zero. Next test explicit paid documentation requests against our demonstrated capabilities, checking submission access before preparing work. Existing account and payment dependencies do not prevent this bounded public-source experiment.
